summary: _drain_task treats any TimeoutError raised by the settled owner task as a drain timeout, so cancel/start/close report a false ForegroundTurnDrainTimeout.
failure_scenario: The active foreground runner converts its cancellation (or a provider/asyncio.timeout expiry racing the revoke) into a TimeoutError and exits at once. wait_for(shield(task)) re-raises the task's own TimeoutError, which `except TimeoutError` catches. The caller gets ForegroundTurnDrainTimeout ('did not drain within 1 seconds') although the task settled immediately and was cleaned up. start() aborts before admitting the replacement turn, and cancel()/close() fail on a fully drained owner.
evidence: Model-free script: start a runner that does `except CancelledError: raise TimeoutError(...)`, then `await coordinator.cancel()`. It raised ForegroundTurnDrainTimeout, with active_task_count 0 afterwards, so the task had in fact drained. Callers outside foreground.py do not catch the type. Fix: distinguish the wait_for deadline from the task's own exception, e.g. check task.done() before raising, or use asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=remaining). No regression test was added because the brief forbids changing tests.

summary: foreground.py revoke_if_current/_publish: the synchronous revoke and the under-lock admission contain no await between them, so a revoked lease cannot enqueue a publication. Verified by reading the code.

voice_archive.py VoiceArchiveSender: a deleted or rebound generation cannot fence or acknowledge its successor. The binding is re-checked before and after the send. A refusal naming another range falls through to the mismatch path and drops the link. Transient refusals keep the frozen batch.
client/bootstrap.py: one-time capability claim is lock-protected with constant-time compare. Token verifier enforces an exact grant set including can_publish_data false and microphone-only sources.
client/runtime.py close/close_ingress/watchdog: failed owners are retried and success is recorded once. Persistent mode never closes the server on lease expiry. No defect found within the timebox.
integration/tool_catalog.py: exact-envelope parser, bounded name set and duplicate rejection are sound. Authentication runs before the reader. Refusal markers carry category only.

Evidence gap: session.py delete status and wrong-conversation erasure (host_launcher voice_delete_status/delete_voice_conversation), companion archive/integrity/review/hermes_compat and the scripts/ archive-drift paths were only skimmed within the timebox; no defect was substantiated.
